response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience and exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP, but lacks clear evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, direct experience with vector databases or RAG architectures, and leadership in customer-facing technical discovery — key requirements for a Staff-level GenAI role.
strengths: Experienced in AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling
Demonstrated full-stack proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud platforms (AWS)
Active open-source contributor with scalable system design experience (GISCollective, Kubernetes)
concerns: No explicit mention of vector databases, RAG, or LLM optimization techniques in resume
Lacks documented leadership in customer-facing technical discovery or enterprise AI deployment
Education shows BS in CS but no advanced degree, and AI experience appears incidental rather than focused
